title: Underwater
author: Joseph SARDIN & Axeline T.
description: Hydrophone recording of a waterfall underwater.
processing: 56-second circular loop with a 4-second crossfade; high-pass 45 Hz, low-pass 1800 Hz, normalized to -24 LUFS; mono MP3 at 96 kbps.
runtimeProcessing: Deep-water EQ before binaural HRTF: 30 Hz high-pass, +4 dB low shelf at 180 Hz, two cascaded 700 Hz low-pass filters.
